No. 1998/8 – TUESDAY, DECEMBER 20, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: KDS/GIK/4/4/34. Land Ministry No. 4-3/5/2015/CEB/32.
The Land Acquisition for construction of Reservoir, Dam, Site premises, Quarry of Hydro power project of Moragolla, Gampola.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No: 28 of 1964, that the Governments intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

The land allotments called Magewatta, Ethgala & Mahawilawatta, Ulapane in total extent of about 5.8272, 1.2054 & 7.6822 Hectares, depicted & prepared by Surveyor General in plan No. maha 6621 & 6622 as shown as lot No. 1-12, 1-3, 1-2 in Grama Niladhari Divisions of Sinhapura Ganga Ihala Korale, Gampolawela & Ulapane in Divisional Secretary Division in Ganga Ihala Korale in Kandy District, Central Province. (The list of particulars are attached.)
